scope: nineteen-node base financial graph at the v4 cold pilot's own arguments, uncapped by node, with a current-RSS trace and the runner/node-loop split. Descriptive measurement, not a build, not a certification, not release eligible.
nesting_note: Rows marked [outer] enclose the unmarked rows beneath them, so their seconds overlap; share_of_process_cpu is per-row and these shares deliberately do not sum to 100.
